background_image_description: Four people stand behind a white table against a plain white wall. From left to right: a man with short brown hair and a gray and blue striped sweater, a woman with long blonde hair and a black sweater, a man with curly brown hair and a dark blue button-up shirt, and a woman with long light brown hair and an orange and blue striped sweater. All are smiling and looking directly at the camera.

nodes.asset_description: Four people are gathered around a white table against a white wall. The person on the far left wears a light blue and white striped shirt and blue jeans, holding a small object in their hands. The person next to them wears a black long-sleeved shirt and has their hands clasped together. The third person has dark curly hair and is wearing a dark blue jacket over a white shirt. The person on the far right wears a blue sweater with orange and blue stripes and has their right hand extended toward the table. A piece of paper lies on the table near the person on the far right.
A blue horizontal line spans the width of the image, positioned centrally. Above and below the line are black horizontal bands. The image is entirely black except for the blue line.
